trigger.description: The trigger for the rebalancing event

rebalancingEventId.description: ID of the rebalancing event to execute

actualCost.description: Actual cost of the rebalancing execution

dryRun.description: Perform a dry run without executing trades

assets.description: Assets and their weights for the backtest

userId.description: User ID for the risk configuration

maxPositionSize.description: Maximum size of a single position

userId.description: User ID for the position size calculation

asset.description: Asset for the position size calculation

userId.description: User ID to subscribe for alerts

status.description: ok = all components up; degraded = some up; error = all critical components down

required.description: Whether a caller or operator must act.

impact.description: Worst-case effect on a caller that does nothing.

generatedAt.description: When this process loaded the changelog.

migrationRequired.description: True when at least one entry forces the caller to act.

key.description: Environment variable name. The value is never returned by any endpoint.

criticality.description: critical dependencies gate readiness; optional ones are advisory only

detail.description: Sanitized explanation. Credentials embedded in driver errors are redacted.

target.description: Target with credentials and query string removed

remediation.example: Horizon is unreachable. Verify egress rules...
remediation.description: Actionable next step for the reported state

status.description: Worst state across critical dependencies. unavailable/misconfigured returns HTTP 503.

advisory.description: Worst state across optional dependencies. Informational only.

networkProbesSkipped.description: True when outbound third-party probes were skipped by policy, so a 'healthy' verdict only reflects local checks.

summary.description: Sanitized, user-safe status summary with zero secret exposure.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Recommended client retry delay in seconds when paused or in maintenance

reason.description: Reason for entering maintenance mode. Any secret or internal host in the text is automatically redacted before public display.
reason.example: Scheduled PostgreSQL minor version upgrade and index maintenance.

estimatedEndAt.description: Estimated completion time (ISO 8601) used to compute Retry-After

reason.description: Audit reason for clearing the maintenance window
reason.example: Upgrade verified and readiness checks green.

reason.description: Reason for the component degradation. Sensitive values are scrubbed automatically.
reason.example: Upstream Ethereum RPC provider experiencing elevated latency.

componentId.description: Target component whose degradation has been resolved

reason.description: Audit note for clearing the component degradation

route.description: API route endpoint (will be normalized automatically)

actorId.description: Ephemeral actor identifier for distinct count calculation. Scrubbed and hashed with daily salt; never saved in plain text.

errorCode.description: Error code for classification (sanitized upon ingestion)

errorMessage.description: Error message for classification (sanitized; raw text not stored)

targetBucketDate.description: Target bucket date (ISO string). Defaults to current hour.

locale.description: Preferred language locale (e.g. en, es, fr, de)

user.description: Target User entity to parse preferred language locale from

id.description: Existing record ID for an owner-scoped update.

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to. Use '*' to receive all events.

tags.description: Tags to associate with the file

olderThanSeconds.description: Delete files older than this many seconds

userId.description: Only clean up files for this user

dryRun.description: Dry run - return what would be deleted without deleting

filters.description: Optional filters for the export scope

retentionDays.description: Retention period in days before the export expires

tenantId.description: Tenant key. Omit to update the global default module state.

config.description: Optional settings isolated to this tenant or global default.

tenantId.description: Tenant key. Omit to disable the module in the global default state.

note.description: Optional note recorded alongside the transition

fromCurrency.description: Source currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

toCurrency.description: Target currency/crypto asset code (e.g. XLM, USDC, BTC, ETH)

fromAmount.description: Decimal string amount in source currency, e.g. '10.5'

spotRate.description: Optional custom spot conversion rate (units of target currency per 1 unit of source currency)

requestDigest.description: Digest of the request stored under this key

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp the price was observed

observedAt.description: ISO timestamp the state was observed. Defaults to the evaluation instant.

consumedDigests.description: Digests of operations already executed for this account

verifiedDestinations.description: Destinations already verified for this account. An empty list means 'unknown' and disables the check.

requiresOraclePrice.description: Whether the operation depends on a fresh oracle price

expectedStateVersion.description: State version the operation was prepared against

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp after which it is invalid

estimatedFee.description: Exact decimal estimate of the network fee

stateVersion.description: Opaque version of the state snapshot

asOf.description: Evaluation instant (ISO). Supplied by the caller; omit to use the server clock.

summary.example: Every decision the reconciler made for this payment, newest first.

state.description: `expanded` sections carry `data`. Critical sections are always expanded.

reason.description: Why the section is not in the response. Critical sections never appear here.

expandedAnnouncement.example: Details expanded. Use the section heading to navigate its contents.

collapsedAnnouncement.example: Details collapsed. Activate the control to reveal them.

focusOrder.description: Recommended reading/tab order. Critical sections come first so risk is announced before detail.

alwaysVisibleSections.description: Sections a client must render expanded by default. Never render these behind a default-collapsed toggle.

message.example: This payment has not been matched to any invoice.

action.example: Review the destination account and payment reference before retrying.

alwaysVisible.description: Always true. Critical warnings are returned at every detail tier and are never confined to the advanced section.

warnings.description: Warnings for this transaction. Independent of the requested tier: a critical warning is always present, even when every advanced section is collapsed.

staleDays.description: An unmatched transaction older than this many days is reported as stale.

limit.description: Maximum number of invoices and transactions to inspect.

toleranceAmount.description: Absolute amount below which a difference is treated as rounding noise (7 decimal places).

includeUserBalances.description: Compare derived per-account totals against the user-facing balance provider when one is configured.

body.example: Your portfolio value has dropped by 5%

deepLink.description: Deep link URL or application route to the relevant workflow

deduplicationKey.description: Deduplication key to ensure retried or duplicate lifecycle events do not create multiple notifications

aggregationKey.description: Aggregation key: notifications with the same key within the cooldown window will be collapsed

notificationIds.description: Notification ID(s) to mark as read

channel.description: Channel to configure (email, sms, push, webhook, in_app)

phoneNumber.description: Phone number for SMS channel (E.164 format)

minPriority.description: Minimum priority to trigger this channel

preset.description: Preset: enable/disable all channels at once

allowPartial.description: Allow valid rows to commit even if some rows fail validation

updateExisting.description: Update existing records if matching externalId is found (idempotent upsert)

stopOnError.description: Stop processing upon encountering the first validation error

entityType.description: Target entity domain for the import batch

dryRun.description: When true, validates and previews changes with ZERO persistent database writes

rows.description: Array of entity rows to import

dryRun.description: Whether this execution was a dry-run (read-only)

totalRows.description: Total number of rows submitted in this batch

createCount.description: Number of new records created or planned for creation

updateCount.description: Number of existing records updated or planned for update

skipCount.description: Number of rows skipped without changes

errorCount.description: Number of invalid rows that failed validation

preview.description: Detailed diff preview of proposed or applied changes

errors.description: Validation errors with exact row locations and remediation guidance

portfolioId.description: Portfolio ID to attach the asset to

externalId.description: External unique identifier for idempotent re-imports

maxAttempts.description: Reset max attempts for the retry

operationId.description: Unique external identifier for the operation

amount.description: Monetary or token amount involved in the operation

historicalAverageAmount.description: Actor's historical average operation amount when known

destination.description: Target destination wallet, contract address, or sink

adapterId.description: Target DeFi adapter identifier when applicable

portfolioExitFraction.description: Fraction of portfolio or DeFi position being exited (0.0 to 1.0)

adapterVerified.description: Whether the target DeFi adapter is verified in the protocol registry

recordOrRecipientCount.description: Number of records or recipients targeted (for exports or notifications)

counterpartyFlagged.description: Whether the counterparty or destination is flagged on a high-risk denylist

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency or correlation key for the operation

asOf.description: Optional ISO timestamp for deterministic evaluation

stepUpVerified.description: Whether a fresh step-up verification (TOTP/wallet challenge) was completed

minutesSinceLastCredentialChange.description: Minutes since the actor's last password, MFA, or API key mutation

mfaEnabled.description: Whether MFA is enrolled on the actor's account

verifiedDestinations.description: Verified destination addresses for this actor

knownDevicesOrIps.description: Known trusted device fingerprints or IP identifiers for this actor

deviceFingerprint.description: Device fingerprint of the current session

reviewApprovalToken.description: Operator review approval token when retrying an approved high-risk operation

decision.description: Operator decision on the queued review item

reason.description: Mandatory audit reason explaining why the operation was approved or rejected
reason.example: Verified treasury rebalance request with account owner via out-of-band confirmation.

proposedPolicy.description: Proposed policy fields to preview against the active domain policy

currentPolicy.description: Optional baseline policy override (defaults to active configured domain policy)

snapshot.description: Optional point-in-time population and record snapshot for simulation

asOf.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for deterministic simulation reproducibility

maxSnapshotAgeSeconds.description: Maximum acceptable snapshot age in seconds before flagging stale
